The '''Citadel Command''' was a large room inside the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]], a large Separatist [[Prison/Legends|prison]] that was designed to hold [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]].

==Structure==
The Citadel's [[warden]] [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]] operated from there, monitoring everything that happened in the Citadel via video screen with the help of a few [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|security droids]] and the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] [[K2-B4/Legends|K2-B4]]. The room had audio control which enabled contact between the command center and [[Starship/Legends|starships]] from outside the planet.

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], after the [[Capture of Even Piell/Legends|capture]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]], a rescue team comprising [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], four other [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]], two [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]] and a trio of captured and reprogrammed battle droids had set off to the Citadel to rescue the [[Lannik (species)/Legends|Lannik]] Jedi Master.

After their ship entered the Lola Sayu [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], Citadel Command contacted them to verify to see that no life-form was on board. They then scanned the ship and because the whole team had themselves [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbon-frozen]], they were not detected.
Soon after the rescue team had breached the prison and rescued Piell, Sobeck viewed their progress via video screen from the Citadel Command. After he saw that all his attempts to stop the team, failed, he growled angrily and left the Citadel Command.<ref name="TC">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode318.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Citadel}}</ref> It was also were Osi Sobeck executed a clone trooper to persuade Even Piell to provide him with half of the [[Nexus Route/Legends|Nexus Route]] coordinates when one part of the rescue team were captured.
